text: TechMart Electronics - Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) Company Overview TechMart Electronics is an India-based consumer electronics retailer focused on reliable devices and trusted after-sales support. TechMart Electronics - Refund and Return Policy Effective Date: 08 July 2026 1. Return Window Customers can request a return within 30 calendar days from the date of delivery for eligible products. 2. Conditions for Refund Eligibility A refund may be approved when: - The delivered product is damaged during transit. - The product delivered is wrong (different model, variant, or color from order). - The product is not as described on the product page.

- The product is not as described on the product page. - The product has a verified manufacturing defect reported within policy timelines. 3. Conditions for Return Acceptance To qualify for a return, the product should: - Be returned with original packaging, tags, manuals, and accessories. - Include all bundled freebies or promotional items. - Be free from customer-caused damage, tampering, or unauthorized repair. - Match the product serial number recorded at dispatch. 4.

- Match the product serial number recorded at dispatch. 4. Non-Refundable / Non-Returnable Items The following items are generally non-refundable unless damaged or defective on arrival: - Software licenses and digital activation keys. - Gift cards and prepaid vouchers. - Opened personal-use accessories such as earbuds or in-ear items (hygiene category). - Products damaged due to misuse, liquid exposure, or accidental breakage.

- Products damaged due to misuse, liquid exposure, or accidental breakage. - Items returned without mandatory components (charger, cable, box, invoice copy where required). 5. Refund Timeline - Once return pickup is completed, quality inspection is performed within 1-2 business days. - After approval, refund is initiated and typically credited within 5-7 business days. - Bank processing timelines may vary by payment method and issuer. 6.

TechMart Electronics - Quick User Manual and Troubleshooting Guide Version: 1.0 1. Device Setup Instructions Step 1: Unbox safely - Verify all accessories are included: charger, cable, quick-start guide, and warranty card. Step 2: Charge before first use - Connect the original charger and charge device to at least 50 percent before setup. Step 3: Power on and initial configuration - Press and hold power button for 3-5 seconds. - Choose language, region, date/time, and accessibility preferences.

- Choose language, region, date/time, and accessibility preferences. Step 4: Connect to WiFi - Select your home/office network and enter password. - Confirm internet connection before account setup. Step 5: Sign in and secure device - Sign in using your account. - Set a strong screen lock PIN/password and enable biometric unlock if available. Step 6: System update - Go to Settings > Software Update and install latest updates. 2.

Step 6: System update - Go to Settings > Software Update and install latest updates. 2. Common Troubleshooting A) Device will not turn on - Charge device for at least 20 minutes using original adapter and cable. - Try a different wall socket and verify cable condition. - Press and hold power button for 10-15 seconds. - If still not responding, perform a force restart as per model instructions. B) Forgot password or PIN - Use Forgot Password/PIN option on lock screen if supported.

B) Forgot password or PIN - Use Forgot Password/PIN option on lock screen if supported. - Authenticate via recovery email/phone/account credentials. - If locked out completely, use official account recovery portal. - Last resort: factory reset (data may be erased). C) Slow performance - Restart device and close unused background apps. - Free storage space (recommended at least 20 percent free). - Remove unnecessary startup apps and cache-heavy files.

- Remove unnecessary startup apps and cache-heavy files. - Update software and critical apps to latest versions. D) Battery draining fast - Reduce screen brightness and timeout duration. - Disable GPS, Bluetooth, and hotspot when not needed. - Check Battery Usage for high-drain apps and restrict background activity. - Avoid extreme temperatures during charging and usage. E) WiFi connectivity issues - Toggle WiFi off/on and restart router. - Forget network and reconnect with correct password.

- Forget network and reconnect with correct password. - Move closer to router and avoid interference zones. - Reset network settings if issue persists. 3. Factory Reset Instructions Warning: Factory reset erases all personal data unless backed up. Step-by-step: - Backup contacts, photos, documents, and app data. - Go to Settings > System > Reset Options. - Select Erase all data (Factory reset). - Confirm with PIN/password and continue. - Wait for reboot and complete initial setup again. 4.
